shifts.name: Department of Impossible Vehicles
shifts.intro: Rooftops are not a public right. Even for creatures who can fly.
shifts.memo: Being able to land somewhere does not constitute permission to land there.
shifts.briefing: Your first assignment is rooftop parking. Expect large vehicles, larger egos, and fireproofing certificates. The regulations are on your left. Please familiarise yourself with them before anything lands.

rules.title: Respect the roof.
rules.description: Declared weight must be 2,000 kg or less.

rules.title: Check the coverage.
rules.description: The authorised zones must include Rooftop. Ground permission alone is insufficient.

rules.title: Fireproofing is mandatory.
rules.description: The fireproofing certificate must be valid on the office date shown above.

applications.name: Aurelia Cinder
applications.quote: The roof was there. I was there. It seemed an excellent arrangement.

applications.name: Percival Drift
applications.quote: I weighed myself before breakfast. Clouds do not have especially heavy breakfasts.

applications.name: Matilda Brass
applications.quote: The chimney is a decorative feature. Mostly.

applications.name: Orson Featherwick
applications.quote: I promise to leave no feathers. I cannot speak for my passengers.

applications.name: Beatrice Hush
applications.quote: The view is quite lovely, and the lift does not accommodate my upholstery.

applications.name: Felix Ember
applications.quote: I inspect chimneys. Naturally, I should be near one.

applications.name: Hector Bellweather
applications.quote: I am considerably lighter when nobody is looking.

applications.name: Juniper Vale
applications.quote: The books weigh more than the broom, but I have declared both.
